column1: # Chapter 3 clauses that state no rule an input can break, read against

column3: Overview: "Verilog-AMS HDL supports integer, genvar, real, and parameter data types as found in IEEE Std 1364 Verilog. It includes the string data type defined by IEEE Std 1800 SystemVerilog. ... Verilog-AMS HDL introduces a new data type, called net_discipline ...". A list of what §3.2–§3.13 define; each rule is cited by those subclauses' own fixtures.

The clause is titled "Multidimensional parameter array examples" and consists of one example ("The following example demonstrates the usage of a multidimensional real array parameter and various usages of assignment patterns."); docs/ch3-datatypes.html's own source note calls it "illustrative, not a standalone executable conformance oracle". The rules it exercises are §3.4.4's and §4.2.14's. Positive fixtures that run it: 77_assignment_pattern_replication.va, 77_assignment_pattern_variable.va.
The clause's whole text is "The following subsections define the namespace."; the rules are §3.13.1–§3.13.4's, each cited separately.
